name: Vowel choir haze pad
desc: A single-voice F-lydian saw pad pushed through a slowly morphing vowel formant filter so it breathes like a wordless choir (aah-ooh-eee), detuned on a slow sine wow signal for tape flutter under a filter breath, re-triggered to pump in the groove with an octave drop each phrase and a vowel pinned to 'iii' at peaks. Angelic mall-fog — a very different haze from the supersaw pad.

code.full: note("[<f3 g3 a3 d3>,<a3 b3 c4 f3>,<c4 d4 e4 a3>,<e4 f4 g4 c4>]*4").add(note(${root})).add(note(sine.range(.05,${det}).slow(16))).s("sawtooth").vowel("<a o u e>").attack(.1).decay(.4).sustain(.4).release(.3).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.5,${cut}*1.1).slow(24)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.5,${gain}).fast(4)).room(${room}).lastOf(8,x=>x.add(note(-12))).orbit(6).play()
code.peak: note("[<f3 g3 a3 d3>,<a3 b3 c4 f3>,<c4 d4 e4 a3>,<e4 f4 g4 c4>,<c5 d5 e5 a4>]*4").add(note(${root})).add(note(sine.range(.05,${det}).slow(14))).s("sawtooth").vowel("<a e i o u>").attack(.06).decay(.35).sustain(.45).release(.25).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6,${cut}*1.4).slow(16)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.5,${gain}).fast(4)).room(${room}).every(8,x=>x.vowel("i")).lastOf(8,x=>x.add(note(-12))).orbit(6).play()
